confirm.title: Confirm an address
confirm.body: Confirm that this mailbox may be used by the MailD MCP account that asked for it.
confirm.done: {{address}} is now confirmed in the account of {{account}}.

account.mcpBody: Master switch for this account: when it is off, every token below is refused immediately.

addresses.title: Addresses
addresses.addHint: A confirmation link is mailed to that address: only someone who can read its inbox can add it.
addresses.checkInbox: Check the inbox of {{address}} for the confirmation link.

disable.title: Disable this address?
disable.body: Tokens will stop using {{address}}. A notice is sent to {{main}}.

enable.title: Enable this address?
enable.body: Tokens may use {{address}} again. A notice is sent to {{main}}.

remove.title: Remove this address?
remove.body: {{address}} leaves this account; adding it again needs a new confirmation. A notice is sent to {{main}}.

tokens.title: Access tokens
tokens.name: Token name
tokens.showOnce: Copy the token now: it is shown only once.
tokens.foreverBody: Anyone holding this token can use your mailbox until you revoke it. Even so, every token is disabled after 30 days without use, and only you can re-enable it from this page.
tokens.revokeBody: "{{name}}" stops working at once and cannot be enabled again.

prefs.confirmSend: Ask me before an agent sends mail

confirmModes.external: Only for recipients outside this server

prefs.confirmHint: When a confirmation is needed, the assistant first gets a preview and has to call again to send.
prefs.signatureHint: Appended to mail sent by agents (up to 2000 characters).
prefs.hiddenHint: Comma-separated folder names. Agents never list, search or touch them (INBOX cannot be hidden).

recover.sent: If that is the admin address, a reset link (valid 30 minutes) is on its way.

reset.title: Choose a new admin password
reset.done: Password changed. Sign in with it now.

password.changed: Password changed; every other admin session was signed out.

user.title: Admin user
user.codeOld: Code sent to the OLD address ({{to}})
user.codeNew: Code sent to the NEW address ({{to}})

domains.title: Domains
domains.hint: Every domain of the mail server is listed; new domains start denied. Double-click a domain (or select it and use the arrows) to move it.

logging.title: Logging

cat.security: Security events (lockouts, captcha, denied scope, rate limits)

logging.masterAlways: Master-token use is always logged, whatever these switches say.

policy.title: User policy
policy.pat_idle_days: Disable tokens idle for (days, at most 30)
policy.resend_base_seconds: First resend wait (seconds, doubles each time)
policy.pat_forever_allowed: Users may create tokens that never expire
policy.allow_external: Agents may send outside this server
policy.force_confirm: Every agent send needs a confirmation
policy.allow_no_confirm: Users may turn send confirmation off
policy.master_notify_user: Mail the mailbox owner when a master token accesses it

master.title: Master tokens
master.hint: A master token opens any mailbox of an allowed domain, ignoring the owners' MCP switch and addresses. Every request names the mailbox in the X-MailD-Act-As header and is always logged.
master.showOnce: Copy the token now: it is shown only once.
master.howTo: Clients send Authorization: Bearer <token> and X-MailD-Act-As: user@domain.

service.title: Service email
service.inactiveHint: The service mailbox is inactive: service mail still goes out, but replies and bounces are lost.
service.passwordKept: A password is stored; leave empty to keep it.
service.testHint: Sends a test message to {{to}} with the saved settings.
service.cleartext: No encryption: the user name and password cross the network in clear text. Use STARTTLS or implicit TLS unless the server is on a network you trust.
service.verifyOff: Certificate verification is off: the connection is encrypted but the server is not authenticated (anyone in the path could impersonate it). Use only for a self-signed or private-CA server you control.

consent.title: Connect an app to your mailbox
consent.wants: wants to access your mail as {{account}}.
consent.mcpOff: MCP access is switched off for this account: the app will be refused until you switch it on.
consent.revokeHint: You can disconnect the app at any time from the Access tokens list.
consent.missing: This page is opened by an app asking for access; start from the app.

connect.title: Connect an assistant
connect.intro: Pick your app. Apps with OAuth (Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code) only need the address: they open a sign-in page here and you choose what they may do. The others take a personal access token from the list above.

how.claude: Claude (web or desktop): Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector, paste this URL and connect; you sign in here and approve the access.
how.chatgpt: ChatGPT: Settings → Connectors → Create (developer mode), paste this URL with OAuth authentication; you sign in here and approve the access.
how.claudeCode: Claude Code: run one of these, then /mcp to sign in (first form) or start using it (token form).
how.gemini: Gemini CLI: add this to ~/.gemini/settings.json, with a token from the list above.
how.mcpRemote: Any app that only runs local (stdio) servers, e.g. Claude Desktop config files: bridge through mcp-remote, with a token from the list above.
how.rest: Scripts and skill-based agents: the same operations over plain HTTP, with a token from the list above.
